step1: Step 1 of 3 · Order like one of your customers
paymentPanel: Your customer pays here by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or chooses to pay at the truck. In the demo, nothing is charged.
bubbleArrived: The order you just placed arrived here instantly, with the collection time. Tap Start cooking.
bubbleReady: When the food is ready, tap Ready. Your customer is told straight away.
told: {name} has just been told their food is ready.
thatsIt: That’s HatchGrab: customers order on their phone, you see it here, they collect without queuing. Your menu is already set up.
startFree: {months, plural, =0 {Start free, keep my menu} one {Start free for # month, keep my menu} other {Start free for # months, keep my menu}}
waitingBody: Order something on the phone. It appears here the moment your customer presses Order.
bandTitle: That’s HatchGrab. Your menu is already set up.
goneBody: Demos are deleted after a day. You can build a new one from your menu in under a minute.
failed: That didn’t work — please try again.
formNote: This is a demo: nobody is charged and nothing is sent, so you don’t need to give an email.
